d.status='POSTED' and d.doc_type in ('RETURN_INSPECT','CUSTOMER_RETURN') ), return_origins as ( select r.product_id,r.transaction_id,r.layer_qty, count(distinct o.document_id) origin_count, return_first_purchases as ( select r.product_id,r.transaction_id,o.document_id,o.doc_no,o.supplier_name_snapshot, o.origin_date,o.deadline, row_number() over(partition by r.product_id,r.transaction_id order by o.origin_date,o.document_id,o.transaction_id) purchase_rank from return_events r join original_inbound o on o.product_id=r.product_id and o.doc_type='PURCHASE_IN' and o.transaction_id < r.origin_before_tx and o.origin_date <= r.origin_before_date ), deadline_layer_quantities as ( select product_id,transaction_id,document_id,doc_no,supplier_name_snapshot, origin_date,deadline,layer_qty,0 origin_unknown,0 origin_first_purchase from original_inbound union all select r.product_id,r.transaction_id, case when r.origin_count=1 then r.document_id else fp.document_id end, case when r.origin_count=1 then r.doc_no else fp.doc_no end, case when r.origin_count=1 then r.supplier_name_snapshot else fp.supplier_name_snapshot end, case when r.origin_count=1 then r.origin_date else fp.origin_date end, case when r.origin_count=1 then r.deadline else fp.deadline end, r.layer_qty,case when r.origin_count=1 or fp.document_id is not null then 0 else 1 end, case when r.origin_count<>1 and fp.document_id is not null then 1 else 0 end from return_origins r left join return_first_purchases fp on fp.product_id=r.product_id and fp.transaction_id=r.transaction_id and fp.purchase_rank=1 ), deadline_layers as ( select l.*,sum(l.layer_qty) over(partition by l.product_id order by l.transaction_id desc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cumulative_qty from deadline_layer_quantities l where l.layer_qty > 0 ), remaining_origin_layers as ( select l.* from deadline_layers l join jewelry_stock cs on cs.product_id=l.product_id where cs.on_hand_qty > 0 and l.cumulative_qty-l.layer_qty < cs.on_hand_qty ), stock_origin_summary as ( select product_id,max(origin_unknown) origin_unknown,max(origin_first_purchase) origin_first_purchase, case when max(origin_unknown)=0 then coalesce(min(case when origin_first_purchase=1 then origin_date end),min(origin_date)) else null end oldest_inbound_date from remaining_origin_layers group by product_id ), remaining_deadlines as ( select l.*,row_number() over(partition by l.product_id order by l.origin_first_purchase desc, case when l.origin_first_purchase=1 then l.origin_date end, l.deadline,l.document_id,l.transaction_id) deadline_rank from remaining_origin_layers l join stock_origin_summary os on os.product_id=l.product_id and os.origin_unknown=0 where l.deadline is not null )

select source_item.*, greatest(0,least(source_item.qty-coalesce(returned.returned_qty,0), coalesce(stock.on_hand_qty,0)-coalesce(stock.reserved_out_qty,0))) remaining_return_qty from jewelry_document_item source_item left join jewelry_stock stock on stock.product_id=source_item.product_id left join ( select return_item.source_item_id,sum(return_item.qty) returned_qty from jewelry_document_item return_item join jewelry_document return_doc on return_doc.document_id=return_item.document_id where return_doc.doc_type='SUPPLIER_RETURN' and return_doc.source_document_id=#{sourceDocumentId} and return_doc.status in ('PENDING_FIRST','PENDING_SECOND','POSTED') and return_doc.document_id != #{excludeDocumentId} group by return_item.source_item_id ) returned on returned.source_item_id=source_item.item_id where source_item.document_id=#{sourceDocumentId} and source_item.qty > coalesce(returned.returned_qty,0) order by source_item.item_id
